title: EOW files chargesheet in khichdi case; eight named
retrievalMethod: Exa full-page fetch of public reporting. Authored factual notes, not a retained full commercial article.
locator: Paragraphs beginning 'In a statement released on Friday', 'As per EOW statement', 'Also, while they have not signed any MoU', and final partner-list paragraph.
notes: EOW statement reported filing a chargesheet before 47th court, Esplanade, on 9 May 2025. This is subsequent to the 4 February 2025 bail order which described an unfiled predicate chargesheet.
Eight defendants reported: Sunil Ramchandra Kadam alias Bala Kadam, Rajeev Salunkhe, Sujit Patkar, Sanjay Mashilkar, Pranjal Mashilkar, Pritam Mashilkar, Suraj Chavan, Amol Gajanan Kirtikar.

The agency alleged procurement ineligibility, lighter packets and use of food/health licences belonging to Sanjay Mali. It alleged no MoU had been signed with Mali and false documentation was prepared; forgery sections were added.
The article attributes ownership of Force One to Sanjay Mashilkar and sons; final paragraph attributes Sahyadri partners Kadam, Salunkhe and Sujit Mukund Patkar.

Reported wrongful-gain headline figure ₹14.57 crore is not imported as an audited loss: it closely matches gross payments ₹8.64+₹5.93 crore and differs from prior alleged gain totals. Original chargesheet and reconciled annexures not retrieved.
Article has ₹6.27 crore where original tribunal later has ₹6.37 crore; discrepancy retained, no silent harmonisation.
No named person's criminal guilt determined by chargesheet; no later trial merits disposition retrieved.
limitations: Original EOW statement, charge sheet, exhibits and current docket were not obtained. Secondary reporting with date bounded procedural status. The article does not provide all defendants' responses.
